item.title: Edible oil prices rise by Rs 10 per litre in Cuttack, consumers express concern
item.description: Prices of edible oil have increased in Odisha's Cuttack over the past few days, leading to concern among consumers and traders. The price of refined edible oil has gone up by Rs 10 per litre, while palm oil has also recorded a price rise in the local market. Traders said the increase has been observed within the last three to four days at Malgodown, one of the major wholesale markets in the city. item.title: Three killed in container–bike collision in Odisha’s Kuchinda
item.description: Three motorists were killed in a head-on collision between a container truck and a motorcycle. The accident took place at Pithamaren under Jamankira police station in the Kuchinda area of Odisha’s Sambalpur district on Monday. Following the accident, emergency services rushed to the spot. The impact of the collision was severe and all three motorcycle riders died in the incident. The exact circumstances leading to the accident are yet to be established.
